content: We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one at hand, which we can get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. We can use carbon_nmr_spectra or proton_nmr_spectra to see signals. Methyl groups show characteristic chemical shifts: 13C around 10-30 ppm, 1H around 0.9 ppm (singlet, doublet etc). We need count of distinct methyl groups (i.e., number of CH3 groups). Use proton NMR to count methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
